faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MoEFCC Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application for the Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) position at MoEFCC is 20th September 2026. Ensure all required documents and information are submitted by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Economics or a related field. Relevant post-qualification experience in climate change and climate finance is also essential. Additional qualifications are desirable.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) role?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for applicants is 40 years. There is no mention of minimum age or age relaxation in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for this contractual position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a remuneration of INR 90,000/- per month for this contractual role as a Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) position at the Ministry of Environment Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the MoEFCC Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) recruitment is entirely online. Candidates need to fill out the application form through the designated Microsoft Form link.

faq.question: Q7. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual position. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis for the role of Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance).

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an online application, followed by submitting your CV via email, and finally, an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the selected candidate be posted?
faq.answer: The Scientific Consultant Grade I (Climate Finance) position is based in New Delhi, under the IPMU, NATCOM Cell, MoEFCC.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, there is no mention of any application fee for this recruitment. Candidates can proceed with their application without any fee.
